qualifications: All analyses are based solely on the provided packet as of 2026-08-31; no external data, geocoding, market comps or outreach were used.
Displayed currency is rounded for readability; lender sizing logic uses unrounded intermediate values per the term sheet.
Annual debt service constants are computed via the standard monthly amortization formula; minor rounding differences may occur absent a spreadsheet.
Only unit 101 has an executed lease extract; for other units, effective contractual rent is taken as printed on the rent roll due to no conflicting signed amendments provided.
Historical T12 presentation includes items below NOI (reserves, capital improvements, debt service, depreciation); these are excluded from operating expenses and NOI per instructions.
Vacant-unit market rents on the rent roll are contextual and not treated as collected income.
Management fee follows the stated underwriting rule: greater of T12 actual ($30,000) and 3.00% of underwritten/stressed EGI.
Sensitivity per instructions: EGI reduced by 5% and sizing rate increased by 100 bps; other operating expenses and reserves held constant; cap rate unchanged.

summary: Juniper Flats underwriting and sizing as of 2026-08-31 are complete from the packet. Rent roll shows 36 units (31,800 sf), 33 occupied, with physical occupancy of 91.67% by count and 91.04% by area. Monthly base rent printed is $62,275 and matches the executed lease for unit 101 ($1,675/mo; expiry 2027-07-31; $1,675 deposit; no renewal exercise evidence). T12 actuals (Sep-2025 to Aug-2026) produce EGI $821,100, operating expenses $307,800, NOI before reserves $513,300, reserves $10,800, and NCF $502,500. Underwriting per the plan yields EGI $854,160, operating expenses $308,200 (incl. management fee at the $30,000 T12 level), NOI before reserves $545,960, reserves $10,800, and NCF $535,160. Using the 5.75% cap on UW NOI before reserves indicates a value of approximately $9.495 million. Lender sizing at a 6.25% underwriting rate and 30-year amortization gives an annual debt constant of ~7.3908%. Constraints are: LTV limit ~$6.172M, DSCR limit ~$5.793M (binding), and debt yield limit ~$6.296M, so the maximum loan is ~$5.793M. The sizing annual amortizing debt service at this loan is ~$428,128 vs. first-year contractual IO debt service at 5.90% of ~$341,766. Estimated cash to borrower after $3.30M payoff, 0.75% origination fee, and $45,000 closing costs is roughly $2.404M. In the combined downside (EGI -5%, management rechecked, other OpEx held, sizing rate +100 bps to 7.25%, cap unchanged), stressed NOI before reserves is ~$503,252, NCF ~$492,452, and the binding DSCR-limited maximum loan is about $4.81M (LTV and debt yield limits are higher). Prepayment friction is 1% in years 1–2 with no stated penalty thereafter and no swap assumed.
